answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded ripple. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra oasis buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the willow is shared, not multiplied. Seal 10281.
